scene.detail: Use the existing “Breathing and linked capnography” panel and its phase buttons/marker. This synthetic trace samples the proximal airway/mouth and has a preset end-tidal value of 40 mmHg. Its phase clock is linked to breathing; CO₂ is independent of mechanics, not measured or model-derived. A lung selection is context, never a capnography measurement. Named phase holds illustrate the trace; no monitoring device, arterial CO₂ calculation or treatment prediction is provided.
